en: What affliction struck Tobit after bird droppings fell into his eyes?
Toward what did Sarah stretch out her hands when she prayed?
Whose son did Azariah claim to be?
Comforting Anna, Tobit said a good what would accompany Tobias?
Beside which river did Tobias catch the fish?
As Tobias left, what share of his property did Raguel give him?
Which animal ran along behind Tobias and Raphael on the way home?
Raphael said they only saw a vision when he seemed to do what?
Raphael said giving alms is better than storing up what?
To which land did Tobit urge Tobias to flee from Nineveh?
